runs.content: Wise plc picked up at today's previous close (845.60 GBX, ~$11.28) — mf-rank-1 Value screen (PE ~24.7x, ROIC 389%, earnings yield 14.4%), down ~22.6% over the past year to near a 52-week low, 19-analyst Buy consensus with 37% upside to a 1,161p target; entered on a second consecutive risk-off session (10Y Treasury yield pushing toward 5.2%, highest since 2004 on the 30Y, on a strong ISM PMI report). CMCSA was exited discretionarily (−6.89%, −$69) to keep the book at 35 open positions after WISE's entry — weakest position in the book, no distinct catalyst break. HUM improved to −9.11%, back off the −10% WATCH line. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,763 (+2.67% on $66,000).

AbbVie picked up at today's previous close ($265.21) — momentum screen (+25.27% 3mo), ECLIPSE Phase 3 migraine trial hit its primary endpoint (Sept 11), RBC reiterated Buy the same day, 30-analyst Buy consensus; defensive-healthcare pick on a broad risk-off day (10Y Treasury yield at its highest since July 2007) where gold miners (NEM −4.18%, FCX −3.33%) fell on the same hawkish-Fed catalyst that ruled out the Materials/Sector-Rotation alternative. NVO was exited discretionarily (−11.56%, −$116) on thesis-deterioration grounds — Novo's Sept 21 Capital Markets Day disappointed on 2030 growth targets and confirmed CagriSema trial setbacks — freeing capacity for ABBV and holding the book at 35 open positions. HUM crossed −10.48% WATCH today, no Burry conflict, held per Step 3D. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,470 (+2.26% on $65,000).
